newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares end firmer as Tenaga news sparks buying.
newsitem.headline: KL shares end firmer as Tenaga news sparks buying.

text.p: The government's announcement to allow Tenaga Nasional to raise its electricity rates helped power stocks to a firm finish, dealers and analysts said.

The overnight jump of Wall Street stocks also provided a positive background for the market to reverse five sessions of losses, they said. "I guess the market was looking for good news. This tariff hike was good news, at least for Tenaga," said an equity salesman at Jardine Fleming.
At the close, the key Composite Index jumped 20.66 points or 1.95 percent to 1,080.17.
The broad Emas index rose 1.94 percent, gaining 5.92 to 311.56.
Energy, Telecommunications and Posts Minister Leo Moggie told a news conference that Tenaga will be allowed to raise power charges by 8.3 percent, or 1.8 cents per unit to 23.5 cents, from May 1.
Tenaga stock jumped 70 cents to 11.60 ringgit on heavy volume of 3.8 million shares.
"With the tariff hike it should be a buy, because now it will translate into a more solid earnings growth," said Soh Meng Hui, head of research at K.L. City Securities.
